zh-Hans:
1.7.0（166）反馈修复测试重点：
• 手记：＋→从 Floe 工作区导入，选择会话或项目生成的 PDF、Office、图片和文本；导入后独立保存，打开进入全屏编辑。增加文档标签，切换保留阅读位置与工具，关闭标签不删除文档；可收起标题栏并保留书写工具。Office 切换先保存。捏笔圆盘直接选择工具，选后立即收起；中心取消，颜色与粗细留在书写栏；Pencil Pro 捏压与系统双击请真机确认。
• 搜索：手记正文、已索引的扫描件和 Office 内容，画布内容及会话正文；检查命中片段和来源跳转。
• Whisper：离开设置后继续下载，取消、重试和重启恢复；语音识别仍优先本地 Whisper，失败回退 Apple。
• 执行环境：Python/Node 包安装后立即使用、升级卸载、HTTPS、shell 引号与管道、取消及重复执行。
• 界面：等待模型响应状态、稳定高度的思考预览、旧工具组自动折叠、画布助手和文件夹整理。
• 浏览器默认保持后台，只有 Agent 明确请求人工协助时打开；搜索仅发现已启用并配置的来源。
iPad 优先，同时检查 iPhone。请先用副本测试导入和编辑。官方 APT 签名仓库和全部候选包/模型尚未交付；不支持的命令会明确报错。本包使用 App Store 接受的 SDK 26 兼容入口，SDK 27 源码另行验证。真机检查由测试者完成。
en-US: Build 166 feedback repair: Import generated PDFs, Office files, images and text from chat/project workspaces using Notes > + > Import from Floe workspace. Imported copies are independently saved and open in the full-screen editor. Document tabs retain reading positions and tools; closing a tab keeps its document. Hide the header while retaining writing tools. Office saves before switching. Check the circular Pencil tool wheel, immediate dismissal after selection and center cancel; colors and widths remain in the writing toolbar and system-configured squeeze/double-tap actions on compatible hardware. Test indexed document/OCR/Office content search, Canvas content and conversation search. Check Whisper downloads after leaving Settings, cancellation, retry and restart recovery. Exercise immediate Python/Node package use, upgrades, uninstall, HTTPS, shell quoting/pipelines and cancellation. Check waiting-for-response UI, stable reasoning previews, automatic folding of older tool groups and Canvas organization. Browser automation stays in the background unless the Agent explicitly requests human help; search discovery includes only enabled/configured sources. Prioritize iPad and also test iPhone using document copies. The official signed APT repository and complete candidate package/model delivery remain unavailable. Unsupported commands report errors. This upload uses accepted SDK 26 compatibility entry points; SDK 27 source is separately tested. Physical-device acceptance is performed by testers.
